extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners and patent practitioners (applicants, patent attorneys/agents)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on unity of invention (restriction/election practice) under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) and related restriction, distinctness, and double-patenting issues during national and national-stage prosecution. Covers when restriction is proper, how to determine independence/distinctness, election and reply practice, rejoinder, and related procedural matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of Invention under the Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: Unity of invention analysis and guidance specific to the PCT context; how the Office treats unity for national stage applications under 35 U.S.C. 371.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The analysis used to determine whether the Office may require restriction differs in national stage applications submitted under 35 U.S.C. 371 (unity of invention analysis) as compared to national applications filed under 35 U.S.C. 111(a) (independent and distinct analysis). See MPEP Chapter 1800, particularly MPEP § 1850, § 1875, and § 1893.03(d). Guidance in this chapter regarding substantive and procedural matters generally applies to national stage applications submitted under 35 U.S.C. 371.
